::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Febry 21st 1889  
**From:** Elderfield  Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection[^1]
:::

[Sir](people/person_2382.qmd)

My only [paper](cmy_books/cmybook_268.qmd) in [Atalanta](organizations/other_53.qmd) is on the Life of [Mr Keble](people/person_798.qmd). Those on Novel writing are by Mr [Walter Besant](people/person_1652.qmd)[^2]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Envelope addressed to 'C T Hiatt Esq/ Sandon/ Wellington/ Salop' and postmarked 1889.
[^2]: This was an autograph hunter's trick to get a signature, see Martin Ray, 'Thomas Hardy's Letter to Charles Hiatt' *Notes and Queries* 53 (2006), 338.
